boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.

methods.candidate_workaround: Run each probe independently and normalize only the documented expected no-match exit.
methods.failure_signature: An aggregate preflight aborts because one read-only discovery command returns an expected no-match exit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not aggregate unrelated read-only probes under fail-fast Promise.all when one command uses exit 1 for no matches.
methods.rollback: Give the aggregate wrapper zero evidence credit and rerun only the required probes independently.
methods.title: Independent receipts for expected no-match probes
trigger_preconditions: A preflight combines instruction discovery with unrelated drive or Git probes.

methods.candidate_workaround: Assign foreach output to an array, then pipe the array to the consumer.
methods.failure_signature: Windows PowerShell raises EmptyPipeElement when a foreach statement is piped directly after a statement block.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use $rows=@(foreach(...){...}); $rows | ConvertTo-Json and never direct foreach-to-pipeline composition.
methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure and replace only the orchestration form, not the underlying inspection.
methods.title: Materialize PowerShell foreach output before pipelines
trigger_preconditions: A PowerShell command needs to serialize objects produced by foreach.

methods.candidate_workaround: Replace the proposal with a substantively different surface and rerun the unchanged threshold.
methods.failure_signature: The x1 builder rejects a proposed title at or above the frozen lexical-overlap threshold.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never lower the novelty threshold to admit a collision; change the research surface instead.
methods.rollback: Retain the rejected proposal and restore the last collision-free x1 candidate.
methods.scope_boundary: Lexical screening is a conservative novelty aid, not proof of scientific novelty.
methods.title: Conservative proposal-title collision replacement
trigger_preconditions: A new core proposal is compared with the complete inherited frozen-title corpus.

methods.candidate_workaround: Select the maximum with an explicit numeric-score key and report the payload separately.
methods.failure_signature: A diagnostic max operation compares payload dictionaries after equal numeric scores tie.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never rely on tuple fallback ordering when later tuple fields are mappings or heterogeneous objects.
methods.rollback: Give the failed diagnostic zero evidence credit and rerun the same data with numeric-key ordering.
methods.scope_boundary: Local diagnostic ordering only; it does not change the novelty threshold.
methods.title: Explicit numeric-key selection for tied diagnostics
trigger_preconditions: A diagnostic ranks tuples containing a score and a structured payload.

methods.candidate_workaround: Set PYTHONUTF8=1 before process launch and rerun unchanged content.
methods.failure_signature: A Python diagnostic fails while printing macron-bearing text through the Windows cp1252 console encoder.
methods.recurrence_guard: Pin UTF-8 before launching Unicode-emitting diagnostics; never transliterate valid source text to satisfy a console locale.
methods.rollback: Retain the encoding failure and rerun the unchanged diagnostic only under explicit UTF-8.
methods.scope_boundary: Console encoding recovery only; it confers no cultural authority or content approval.
methods.title: Pre-launch UTF-8 for Unicode diagnostics
trigger_preconditions: A Windows child process may print te reo Maori or other non-ASCII source text.

methods.candidate_workaround: Use datetime.astimezone with the configured Windows timezone and verify its UTC offset is plus twelve or plus thirteen hours.
methods.failure_signature: Python cannot resolve the Pacific/Auckland IANA key because the optional tzdata package is absent on Windows.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not install tzdata merely for a phase timestamp; fail closed if the configured local offset is not a valid New Zealand offset.
methods.rollback: Retain the missing-zone failure and omit local-time credit if the configured offset check fails.
methods.scope_boundary: Timestamp rendering only; it does not change the host timezone or install a package.
methods.title: Windows-local New Zealand timestamp fallback
trigger_preconditions: A phase timestamp needs New Zealand local time on a host already configured to that timezone.

methods.candidate_workaround: Read and validate the exact frozen enum rather than substituting a reviewer-local synonym.
methods.failure_signature: A validator rejects a valid frozen route because it expects an unfrozen synonym for the same message mode.
methods.recurrence_guard: Treat serialized lifecycle enums as contracts and centralize or import them when practical.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed review and keep the freeze blocked until validator and frozen contract agree exactly.
methods.scope_boundary: Route-mode vocabulary only; no message has been sent.
methods.title: Exact frozen route-enum validation
trigger_preconditions: A phase contract serializes a route or lifecycle enum that later validators must inspect.

methods.candidate_workaround: Compute the total from its authoritative component counts and validate the same equation.
methods.failure_signature: A projected retained-negative total remains hard-coded after the operational-negative list grows.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never hand-update a derived negative total; retain components and calculate the projection at generation time.
methods.rollback: Retain the stale receipt and block the freeze until the recomputed total and component counts agree.
methods.scope_boundary: Bookkeeping correction only; it does not transform a failed result into a pass.
methods.title: Dynamic retained-negative arithmetic
trigger_preconditions: A phase derives an effective total from inherited, operational, and synthetic negative counts.

methods.candidate_workaround: Classify only exact reviewed scanner-definition paths separately while retaining payload-hit treatment everywhere else.
methods.failure_signature: A staged privacy scan treats a scanner's literal pattern definition as a confirmed payload hit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Keep a narrow exact scanner-definition set; never exempt a directory, wildcard, generated artifact, or unrelated script.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed scan and keep the commit blocked if any candidate occurs outside an exact scanner-definition path.
methods.scope_boundary: Literal scanner definitions only; zero structural hits are not complete privacy assurance.
methods.title: Exact scanner-definition privacy disposition
trigger_preconditions: A staged source file contains the exact privacy regular expressions it executes.
